result.brief: 提出可行驶区域与碰撞关键区域感知的世界-动作模型，从RGB世界模型潜空间预测未来几何，联合建模驾驶可供性与空间结构以提升轨迹规划。
result.reason: World-action model jointly predicts future geometry from RGB world-model latents and affordance regions for driving; contributes to world modeling and spatial representation, though primarily an autonomous-driving application.
